title: partnerships-marketplace-daily-notes-taylor
content:
Daily scratchpad - quick reminders + next steps for partner integrations. Mostly notes to self; messy.

Morning stand notes (03/01):
- Quick sync with Ava about Acme onboarding. They want SSO + private deployment options. Need to confirm legal with compliance team.
- Jordan demoed the marketplace listing flow; UX about pricing tiers still TBD.
- Samir flagged latency questions for Redwood Dedicated minimums (GPUs per pool) - follow up with infra.

Priorities for today:
1) Send updated onboarding checklist to Acme (include SSO steps + expected timeline).
2) Draft integration checklist for Marketplace listings (minimal + recommended fields).
3) Create JIRA tasks for infra latency investigation and add Samir as assignee.
4) Sync with Product on pricing tiers for marketplace (A/B pricing idea).

Notes / TODOs (short):
- Email Acme: attach onboarding checklist, ask for SSO IdP metadata (due 2026-03-03).
- Add SSO checklist item: test IdP sign-in flow in private deploy env (dev cluster).
- Confirm whether we can support per-customer KMS rotation in Marketplace private deployments.
- Add marketplace listing screen screenshots to confluence page.

Integration checklist (work-in-progress):
- [ ] NDA signed (legal) - contact: Jordan (@legal)
- [ ] Partner account created in staging (ops)
- [ ] SSO metadata received and tested (security)
- [ ] Model version pinned + quantization profile set (applied-ml)

Quick links: confluence/Marketplace Partner Onboarding, JIRA MP-1023, PR: github.com/repo/partner-integration/pull/45

Notes to self: keep checklist minimal for first launch; we can add advanced sections (KMS rotation, private deploy cert ops) as separate annexes.
todo: Create JIRA MP-1024: infra latency investigation (assignee: Samir)
Reach out to Compliance re: private deployment KMS support
meeting_summary: 03/01 sync: Acme onboarding moving forward pending legal; need clarity on pricing tiers for marketplace and infra latency baseline for Dedicated. Action owners assigned (Ava: onboarding doc, Jordan: pricing doc, Samir: infra tickets).
blockers: Legal review for SSO + private deployment contract clauses
Clear infra SLA numbers for Dedicated (GPU pool sizing)
